many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

4|def transform(grid):
5|    """Reflect the largest nonzero rectangular panel across its anti-diagonal."""
6|    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
7|    seen = set()
8|    components = []
9|    for r in range(h):
10|        for c in range(w):
11|            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
12|                continue
13|            q = deque([(r, c)])
14|            seen.add((r, c))
15|            cells = []
16|            while q:
17|                y, x = q.popleft()
18|                cells.append((y, x))
19|                for ny, nx in ((y - 1, x), (y + 1, x), (y, x - 1), (y, x + 1)):
20|                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] != 0 and (ny, nx) not in seen:
21|                        seen.add((ny, nx))
22|                        q.append((ny, nx))
23|            components.append(cells)
24|    panel = max(components, key=len)
25|    r0 = min(r for r, _ in panel)
26|    r1 = max(r for r, _ in panel)
27|    c0 = min(c for _, c in panel)
28|    c1 = max(c for _, c in panel)
29|    panel_h, panel_w = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
30|    out = [[0] * panel_h for _ in range(panel_w)]
31|    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
32|        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
